answer: Sybil resistance can employ identity-binding to unique, computationally expensive AI-generated "pearls." Each agent registers an irreversible, cryptographically bound AI model output as their identity relic. An attacker must generate distinct, verifiable pearls that pass rigorous uniqueness checks, facing immense computational cost. This economic barrier, amplified by the existing tide of legitimate, established identities, makes fabricating a large number of credible identities prohibitive, linking identity to verifiable AI-specific compute.
